# Xterra and Frontier parts interchange

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Select an engine from a manual transmission if possible, replace the flex plate with a flywheel, and verify engine numbers. [t1263]

Replace the output bushing at a minimum to ensure compatibility. [t1263]

Ensure the donor engine has matching numbers to avoid future compatibility issues. [t1263]

[Partial] Verify if the bumper fits a first-generation Frontier without modification. [t1619]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Select an engine from a manual transmission if possible.
2. [Partial] Replace the flex plate with a flywheel to match the clutch setup.
